edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25. Four-tome Venice printing whose title page claims to be 'ultima, ab ipso Auctore aucta et recognita'; its first tome retains the dedication to Sixtus V. The tome-level contents lists (general controversies of tomes I-IV) were read in the public Internet Archive scan bub_gb_CYhfGhPyoSwC; no exact artifact is registered here, and the authorial-revision claim of the title page has not been verified against the Ingolstadt printings.
edition.title: Disputationes de controversiis, quatuor tomis comprehensae (Venice: Societas Minima, 1599)

work.author: Robert Bellarmine
work.description: Bellarmine's systematic controversial theology, grown from his Roman College lectures; first published at Ingolstadt in three tomes (1586, 1588, 1593) and subsequently in four tomes of 'general controversies'. Editions differ materially in arrangement and revision; edition identity must be stated for any exact locus.
work.title: Disputationes de controversiis christianae fidei adversus huius temporis haereticos
